column1: Prototype limits and fixes found by the test
Limit: the prototype keeps one own Quest. Starting a new Quest and leaving it blanks the published one, so the test re-arranges it before Manage.
Limit: the Published filter on the Quests tab is never empty in the prototype (a sample Quest is always there).
Limit: a returning user sees the username and welcome screens again on every sign-in. The real app shows them on first sign-in only; ftue_step_viewed must not fire for returning users.
Fixed: a new Quest now starts on the default visibility from Settings (it kept the last Quest's setting).
Fixed: opening a shared link from the screen menu now starts signed out, and leaving the friend view resets it.
Fixed: two fast taps on Next both count as page turns.
